Hi Sarah / team —

Quick note from the solutions side on what we'd like to cover during the architecture review so your security/infra folks can prepare: 
- Required outbound endpoints and recommended egress controls (we can present an allowlist).
- Options for private connectivity (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink vs. customer-managed NAT).
- KMS integration patterns (bring-your-own-key, HSM options, rotation cadence).
- Logging, retention, and audit exports (what we emit and how to ingest).
- Service accounts and least-privilege IAM recommendations.

If you can share the two most important concern areas (e.g., egress controls + key custody), we'll prioritize those first.
